recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the WG's no-invariant decision while making the DICOM compatibility guidance accurate for the current AuditEvent structure; no broader DICOM mapping review was found necessary for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32473 was a Published Security WG change request for AuditEvent, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to remove the invariant prohibiting both entity name and query, and instead add soft guidance that DICOM AuditMessage compatibility avoids populating both.
initial_application: Commit b4165b6d58 removed the sev-1 invariant and the name/query conditions from source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml, and added a DICOM compatibility note to AuditEvent.entity.query. The invariant removal was already present in current source.
additional_context: Related Published R5 issue FHIR-32472 removed AuditEvent.agent.name and AuditEvent.entity.name in commit 8a350024ed because their content moved to Reference.display. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes AuditEvent, and the pre-reconciliation AuditEvent.entity.query note still referred to the removed .name element even though the current name-like location is AuditEvent.entity.what.display / DICOM ParticipantObjectName.
reconciliation: Changed source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml so AuditEvent.entity.what carries the DICOM compatibility note for .what.display (ParticipantObjectName) with .query (ParticipantObjectQuery), and so AuditEvent.entity.query no longer references removed .name. The removed invariant remains absent.
source_changes: source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml: added DICOM AuditMessage compatibility guidance to AuditEvent.entity.what using .what.display / ParticipantObjectName and .query / ParticipantObjectQuery.
source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml: updated AuditEvent.entity.query's compatibility note to remove the stale .name reference and point to .what.display instead.

related_jiras.note: Removed AuditEvent name elements and moved name-like content to Reference.display, which determines how FHIR-32473's note should be represented now.
